summary: Declare the corrected defended-measurement contract (measurement_contract=matched-final-state-v2) that the frozen-study runner requires before held-out execution of defended arms. The defended-pilot measurement-stage correction (commits 8574117/7ef4edd/efa4e50) landed after v2 was frozen, so v2's defended-capture arms cannot execute held-out as-is. No cells, axes, seeds, budgets, statistics, corpus or frozen_inputs change — this amendment only records the measurement contract under which the v2 defended cells are executed and evaluated. Evidence: the corrected defended pilot analysis (utility stages verified per-cell against the contract by experiments/analyze_defended_pilot.py:108).

changes.rationale: Defended and undefended utility/leakage are measured at matched final training state (corrected stage assignment verified in the defended development pilot); the runner refuses held-out defended execution without this declaration (experiments/validate_reconstruction.py:307). Required to execute the v2 capture_defenses axis.

decisions: Frozen v2 remains immutable; v3 differs from v2 only by the measurement_contract declaration and version/status fields.
The bottleneck sweep negative outcome (experiments/bottleneck_sweep_selection_v1.json) is unchanged and no bottleneck arms are added.
Freeze of v3 requires explicit user approval; the automated pipeline drafts but never freezes.
